resolution.calibration_note: calibrate() re-measures steps/mm = travel_steps / switch-to-switch distance (204 mm X, 262 mm Y); the accuracy of that distance (a hardware measurement) scales every coordinate: a 0.1 % error in 204 mm = 0.2 mm at the far end
